positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led the migration of legacy FORTRAN automation code for emission calculation to python based platform, in order to improve compatibility with different applications
•	Made modifications to existing VBA system to update compatibility with new data format
•	Identified and developed software modules to streamline the process of data identification, extraction and processing for automated emissions calculations 
•	Performed integration and regression testing to verify modification impacts, mainly, with regards to processing efficiency and compatibility with various data formats. 
•	Designed and developed scalable test automation frameworks in python to simplify the built process to generate test schedules for tests with varying requirements across different engine platforms 
•	Developed python based tools for parallel data processing on multiple files spread across multiple cores for improved efficiency
•	Developed automated tools for analyzing performance test results, publishing the results to the concerned stake holders with detailed monitoring stats, observations and recommendations.
•	Designed SQL database to effectively store test specific data belonging to different formats, and query it for further analysis
•	Developed Python based scalable tools complete with GUI to allow for remote control of test configuration as well as output data preparation/analysis/validation and report generation
•	Led the initiative to define and implement appropriate methodology for a software platform shift from existing database framework to a ‘Graphical Database’ to enhance user experience and improve efficiency

positions.title: Powertrain Durability  Engineer
positions.description:
•	Interface with systems groups to analyze system level requirements and translate that to component level specifications with focus on Electric water pump, valve train, oil pumps, mechanical thermostats, bearing testing
•	Work with suppliers and platform engineers to develop optimized testing methods; and identify equipment setup and hardware/software component integration to simulate test framework for all functional verifications
•	Maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, CAN, LIN, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
•	Conduct data analysis to evaluate and troubleshoot testing anomalies, as well as perform component and architecture trade studies to determine optimal system solutions
•	Communicate technical issues and project timelines with building leadership, operations and the maintenance team
•	Manage efficient allocation of resources spanning cross functional teams to meet critical milestones for key development projects.
•	Assist in developing integration plans identifying timelines, resources and equipment requirements to integrate engineering designs into higher level products

positions.title: I&C Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Responsible and accountable for designing and scheduling successful modifications of complex electrical systems involving potential transformers, breakers, and power distribution systems, including components relating to protection, control, and metering systems.
•	Prepare design deliverables such as: design plans, conceptual engineering reports, design change packages, design change notices, FMEA, calculations, and requirement tractability matrices.
•	Support engineering products through entire life cycle including; providing technical guidance for installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and creating test specifications for In-Circuit (ICT), Functional Test (FT) and End-of-Line (EOL) testers.
•	Contribute in substantial capacity to electrical requirements analysis, definition and management
•	Conduct risk assessment studies using failure mode analysis through every phase of the design to ensure compliance to applicable codes and standards (IEEE, NFPA, etc.), and develop DFMEA’s and DRBFM’s as required per design.
•	Worked with customer engineering, purchasing and quality groups to support Requests for Information, Requests for Quote, new designs and quality issues.
•	Supports product design cost optimization using design analysis, Bill of Material reviews and conduct functional safety assessments to propose efficiency improvements
•	Generate requirement based and safety driven hardware definitions for electrical modifications by developing point-to-point wiring schematics and electrical/electronic component specification, and follow it up with quality checks for instrument datasheets, location plans, and control wiring diagrams to ensure lessons learned are implemented.
•	Project highlights: Remote Indication for Emergency Bus, Fire Suppression System upgrade, Distributed Control System upgrade, Freeze protection upgrade

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
• Assisted in major engineering change tactical intercom which involved: 
   o Reviewing security sensitive Technical drawings
   o Reviewing and Preparing engineering documents such as bill of materials 
   o Obtained  Safeguards Information security clearance
• Assisted in Fukushima Plant modifications which involved:
   o Developing and improving risk analysis tools
   o Providing technical support for customer architect engineer meetings
• Played an instrumental role in the decision to expand the engineering scope of modifications to   
  the insulation of the reactor vessel by reviewing and analyzing engineering calculations.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained reactor simulation code
• Reviewed simulation code for system configuration errors
• Demonstrated strong organizational, management, communication and interpersonal skills.
